scope: Read-only observations of repository media, the existing local GIF preparation tool, and an existing Thor runtime environment. No installations, service changes, environment exports, or historical-use conclusions. This inventory identifies technical provenance; it does not grant license, patent, asset-rights, or release approval.
distinctions: Media data files contain encoded streams, not the FFmpeg/TorchCodec/OpenCV implementation.
A Python wrapper license does not determine the license of the bundled or linked native FFmpeg build.
Compiled codec lists are separate from observed loading, tested functionality, and historical execution.
Current host state does not qualify a new installation or prove which tool created earlier training/media artifacts.

media.origin_documentation: Project asset inventory records a 2026-09-14 conversion of the owner-supplied recording with FFmpeg 7.0.2 at 10 fps, 128-color palette, Bayer dithering.

The public NVIDIA r39.2 source index was checked and listed only the newer 7:8.0.1-nvidia1 source record. The direct 8.0.1-nvidia source descriptor URL returned HTTP 404 in the companion audit. No exact matching modified source archive/build recipe for the installed version was established; the newer candidate source is not a substitute for the installed artifact. Host apt source metadata was also unavailable without configured deb-src entries.

origin.verification: Downloaded the published wheel without installing or executing it; verified its SHA-256 against PyPI metadata and hashed the ZIP FFmpeg member. Its digest exactly matches the retained executable.
origin.limitation: This establishes a current published wheel containing identical FFmpeg bytes; it does not prove the historical download URL, original installation event, or source/build reproducibility.

project_conversion_preflight.evidence: Saved successful preflight result matches this executable SHA-256, version, and complete configuration.
project_conversion_preflight.scope: Exercises a synthetic one-frame CPU conversion through libx264; does not establish a full dataset conversion, training run, historical use, or legal approval.

upstream_fallback_recipe.context: Upstream fallback installs FFmpeg development packages and sets CUDA 13.0 include/library paths. It is used only if no prebuilt wheel is found.
upstream_fallback_recipe.relationship_to_wheel: This is an available fallback recipe, not an attestation of how the reviewed LFS wheel was built. The installer does not name embedded abbreviation 0b261b9 or record the wheel builder/compiler, patches, exact FFmpeg build, or a reproduced wheel hash.

torchcodec.current_project_installation: Pinned/checksummed wheel overlay after frozen dependency sync; no source-build fallback and no unversioned ffmpeg CLI installation.
torchcodec.remaining_provenance_gap: Resolve the embedded source abbreviation to a full revision, establish any patches and complete build inputs/recipe for the exact supplied wheel, and attest or reproduce the artifact.

observed_loading.method: Read-only native-library names from running GR00T policy-process memory maps.
observed_loading.meaning: Only OpenCV FFmpeg 5 libraries were observed in the sampled live policy processes. This is a point-in-time observation, not proof of absence in other processes or times and not proof of codec-function execution.

reproduction_commands.native_library_identity: Read av_version_info(), avcodec_configuration(), and avcodec_license() from each specific library; enumerate av_codec_iterate() with av_codec_is_encoder()/av_codec_is_decoder(). Hash each resolved library file.
reproduction_commands.media_inspection: <ffmpeg> -hide_banner -nostdin -i <media-file> -f null -t 0 -; parse GIF image descriptors, loop extension, and graphic-control delays.
